name: SignatureSetup
description: Represents the information used to set up a signature packet.
example:
Dim objSigSetup As SignatureSetup
With objSigSetup
.AllowComments = True
.ShowSignDate = True
.SigningInstructions = "Please sign this document."
.SuggestedSignerEmail = "jdow@example.com"
Next

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SignatureSetup object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SignatureSetup object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: ReadOnly
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value indicating whether the SignatureSetup object is read-only. Read-only.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Gets the ID of the signature provider for a document. Read-only.

properties.name: SignatureProvider
properties.description: Gets a value identifying an installed signature provider add-in. Read-only.

properties.name: SuggestedSigner
properties.description: Gets or sets the name of the principle signer of the document. Read/write.

properties.name: SuggestedSignerLine2
properties.description: Gets or sets the second line of suggested signer information (for example, title). Read/write.

properties.name: SuggestedSignerEmail
properties.description: Gets or sets the email address of the signer of the document. Read/write.

properties.name: SigningInstructions
properties.description: Gets or sets the instructions for signing the document. Read/write.

properties.name: AllowComments
properties.description: Gets or sets a Boolean value specifying whether the signer can enter comments in the Sign dialog box. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowSignDate
properties.description: Gets or sets a Boolean value indicating whether the date the document was signed should be displayed. Read/write.

properties.name: AdditionalXml
properties.description: Gets or sets any additional XML information added to the signature during setup. Read/write.
